knowledge.title: Natural Botanical Hair Mask – Mini Luxe
knowledge.content: Roots & Leaves Collection ka Natural Botanical Hair Mask – Mini Luxe website par current offer price ₹999 aur displayed MRP/reference price ₹1799 ke saath listed hai. Website Free Pan-India Shipping aur Cash on Delivery (COD) dikhati hai. Listed ingredients: Amla, Bhringraj, Hibiscus, Fenugreek, Aloe Vera aur Curry Leaves.
